fixedIssues: FM now detects an NVLSM crash by checking GRPC returns codes, and calls abort when it detects that NVLSM is no longer alive.
Added an error check on the attempt to use state, which depends on specific RPC success in UVM.

Changed the Single Node FM's behavior, and it stops processing newGpuEvent, similar to MN systems. Instead it processes NoGpuPKeyEvent, which always happens post-GPU handshake, ensuring moduleId and archId are valid.
When setting up a MAD buffer, an error path was missed and now it is fixed by handling all error conditions.
The new NVML API has been added to the Windows export list.
Added a check for CX port status before starting the FM service.
